name: gap_exhaustion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, gap openings (>0.5%) trigger 10-30 minutes of sustained directional participation — momentum algos, retail FOMO, and index arbitrage all push the index to successive new session extremes. As this absorption process nears completion, each new extreme is made on shrinking 5-second volume: the institutional buyers (gap-up) or sellers (gap-down) have been absorbed and remaining order flow is retail noise. When MFI(3-min) reaches extreme levels (>72 or <28) AND 5-second volume falls below the session average while price is at or near the session extreme, the exhaustion is confirmed. VWAP-benchmarked funds and short-gamma market-makers then initiate counter-trend flow.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.5% day with price near session extreme, recent volume < 72% of 3-min baseline, and MFI + RSI both in overbought/oversold territory signaling exhaustion reversal
